availability_rules.daily_update: once per UTC day before the first T-60 decision; labels with release_at < first_decision_at only
availability_rules.decision_time: T-60; calibration inputs are restricted to labels released before that UTC day's first decision
availability_rules.execution_time: T-59; T-59 snapshots determine execution only
availability_rules.forecast_timestamp_provenance: Saved BASE70 OOF rows have missing prediction_available_at_utc; OOF row presence is observed, and T-59 availability is an explicit one-second-contract assumption.
availability_rules.unresolved_outcomes: retain qualified intents and fills; exclude unresolved fills from settled PnL and report separately

calendar.comparison: development market starts with all four probabilities available after the Platt warm-up; include markets irrespective of trades, side, execution, or label availability
calendar.quality_labels: official binary outcomes whose label release is no later than the development cutoff

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over shared UTC calendar days

policy.side_tie_break: existing engine rule: equal positive EV chooses UP

variants.PLATT: saved BASE70 probability after existing causal daily Platt calibration
variants.PRIOR: available prior official UP labels / available prior official labels

next_step: Experiment complete; no follow-up experiment is started automatically.

summary.side_selection_rule: positive net EV side at requested amount
